common.objection: We already use several security tools.
common.response: Acknowledge tool sprawl, then explore whether they still struggle with prioritization, visibility, or manual triage.

common.objection: We do not have budget right now.
common.response: Probe whether timing is the issue, then offer a smaller discovery conversation to size fit before formal budgeting.
Offer a concise follow-up and try to confirm the most relevant angle so the message is useful.
